new_problems: Until w8-status-write lands, the guide says the status issue is on (guideStatusIssueState returns 'on'): AGENTS.md tells agents to read and announce in a pinned 'Forerunner status: <name>' issue that this base does not create yet. Ship both together or make guideStatusIssueState answer from the real issue state.
The guide refreshes only at a session's end: a Settings change (merge mode, checks) reaches GitHub after the next session, not at once.

The fake daemon's together Docs rows mark every row, the app's Status included, as 'The other Forerunner ... writes this doc'; the real daemon shows the Status row as 'Kept in the app: ...'. The mismatch predates this area (the fake's list always included docs/status.md).

A together project accepts a merge_mode change through PUT /projects/:id/settings (Bob's case did it); the guide's 'who merges' fact is the maker's only, so the setting has no effect on the guide; whether the screen should offer it is w8-together's call.
The optional status branch (fr/status, off by default) still writes docs/status.md on its own branch; w8-status-write replaces it with the issue.
notes_for_other_areas: w8-status-write: guideStatusIssueState(project) in packages/runtime/src/loop/guide.ts is the one place the issue's state enters the guide (return 'switched_off' or 'issues_off'); the facts' key (guideKeyOf, recorded at summary_cache.docs.guide_key) then differs and ProjectDocs.refreshGuide opens one docs pull request at the next session's end (call it right after a state change if it must be at once). The issue's number is never a fact.

w8-status-write: ownsUnmarkedDocs / the sole-linked fallback stays only for the status writer (isProjectStatusPr with soleLinked); docsPrListing(project, pr, {soleLinked}) returns 'own' | 'listed' | null for the Overview; STATUS_TEMPLATE and applyStatusUpdate remain for fr/status until you remove it.
Decisions: decisionRecordFor(workspace, day) and DECISION_RECORD_MARK (session/person-questions.ts) name the project's decision record; FIRST_DECISION_PATH is docs/decisions/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md.
capabilities: UNFINISHED_WORK_RULES, WIP_STOPPED_HEADING, WIP_LEFT_HEADING and guideChangeLine(changedFiles) are exported from githost/pr-executor.ts.
Intake: recordDocsOutcome writes summary_cache.docs {location, branch?, pr_url, intake_at} or {error, failed_at, intake_at}; scaffoldLeftNoMarker reads intake_at or scaffolded_at.

Docs route: DOC_ROWS = STANDARD_DOCS + docs/status.md; titles 'Guide' (AGENTS.md), 'Guide for Claude Code' (CLAUDE.md); a together project's guide rows carry notWrittenHere with togetherDocNote also when the copy has them.
Take-over retry: TakeOverRetryFailure = blocked | branches | refused | unreachable; DocsScaffoldOutcome.stopped = pull_request_open | branches_taken; RepositoryUse.locatorOf(project).
